title: DSLO v0.8 — Federated Geometry Constellation
description: Canonical public-layer release of the DSLO Federated Geometry Constellation, defining federated geometry, domain-class geometry, invariant surfaces, mapping surfaces, registry anchors, formatting surfaces, and the expanded v0.8 glossary. Version 0.8 is strictly additive, geometry-only, invariant-preserving, non-runtime, and non-agentic. It inherits exclusively from DSLO v0.7 substrate and manifold lineage.
